name: Perovskite Global Property Benchmark
description: Benchmark assessing global property prediction methods on open-source perovskite-like datasets for materials property prediction.
reputation: An academic benchmark derived from a peer-reviewed ACS Omega study; used within the materials-science ML community but not widespread outside that field.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on materials-property prediction; dataset sizes can be modest and property-specific, so results may vary by target and risk contamination from experimental/duplicate entries.
